dedupe_keys.name: image dataset for illegal dumping detection in urban areas of bangladesh 804 real images 3 557 after augmentation

description: This dataset supports machine learning to detect illegal dumping in city streets of Bangladesh. It was deposited on Mendeley Data in September 2026 by Ruhul Amin and colleagues at the University of Dhaka. Images are labelled in two classes: positive images showing visibly dumped waste, and negative images of clean urban scenes. The original set has 804 real photographs, 326 of dumps, 288 clean scenes and 200 so-called critical clean scenes that resemble dumps, split 70, 20 and 10 percent into training, validation and test sets. Augmented images were added to the training set only, so validation and test data remain real, giving 3,557 images in total. The files are free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 licence, and the authors ask users to cite the linked research paper. Coverage is urban areas of Bangladesh, without a list of cities. Caveats: a small real sample, image-level labels only and no locations or dates. Simulation uses: training and testing image classifiers that could flag dumping hotspots for waste enforcement and collection models. Related records: KerbTrack-Syn (data-kerbtrack-syn-synthetic-kerbside-bulk-waste-images) offers synthetic bulk waste images, and the Huangtu rural waste remote sensing data (data-huangtu-rural-waste-remote-sensing) detect waste from above.
